name: Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 4 Mobile Workstation (Rose-Hulman's Choice)
description: Chosen by Rose-Hulman as the standard freshman laptop package! I'm primarily a Mac user, so this absolute beast of a machine has been sitting in its sleeve and was hardly ever used. Unleash extreme commercial-grade performance anywhere you go! This premium Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 4 is a lightweight engineering powerhouse wrapped in a high-end Carbon Fiber weave top cover and a solid Magnesium Alloy bottom chassis. Packing an 8-core 11th Gen Intel Core i7-11800H processor, 16GB of fast 3200MHz RAM, a 512GB NVMe SSD, and a dedicated 4GB graphics card, it breezes through complex CAD modeling, 3D rendering, heavy data compiling, and IDE software required for classes. Features a stunning, color-accurate 16-inch 16:10 professional anti-glare display with narrow bezels, dual smart cooling fans, and that legendary ThinkPad durability. Practically like-new and ready to tackle your entire engineering curriculum!
contact_note: Perfect for incoming Rose-Hulman freshmen or engineering students! Avoid the university markup. Laptop has been fully factory reset, meticulously cleaned, and sanitized. Includes original Lenovo high-capacity charging block. Available for immediate local pickup around Terre Haute!
meta_description: Like-new Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 4 16" mobile workstation. Official Rose-Hulman freshman computer specification. Features i7-11800H, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, and 4GB dedicated graphics card.
name_zh: 联想 Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 4 碳纤维工程移动工作站 (Rose-Hulman新生官方机)
